propositions: review_interrupts metric is published without reason dimension, preventing CloudWatch alarms from distinguishing bound-exceeded (bot busy, drain check working) from signal-unavailable (health probe broken, deploys run blind)

two new dimensionless metrics review_interrupts_bound_exceeded and review_interrupts_signal_unavailable are published separately alongside unchanged rolled-up review_interrupts using existing publish_autodeploy_marker_delta helper with regex patterns on JSON reason field

two new CloudWatch alarms replace the single review_interrupts alarm, each scoped to one reason metric with distinct remediation in description, while rolled-up alarm is removed to prevent double-paging
signal-unavailable alarm retains 900s period with evaluation_periods=1 and datapoints_to_alarm=1 to maintain prompt detection of blind deploys
terraform apply must be executed post-merge to activate the new alarm definitions in the live account
